rule: per outer fold, each family's variant minimises the pooled universe log-loss (eps 0.01) of the other four folds; exact ties: smaller K, larger tau, genome before species, genus before family, smaller alpha. Carried forward: the configuration chosen in most outer folds (same tie order); per-hyperparameter modes are reported for reference.

winner.name: E4(E3)
winner.rule: among composites whose nested-CV universe-Brier and union-support-Brier contrasts vs E0 both have group CIs below 0 (the design's decision rule), the lowest pooled nested-CV universe log-loss (the tuning criterion)
